"""URL slugs."""

import re
import unicodedata


def slugify(title):
    """Lowercase ASCII slug: accents folded to base letters, words joined by single hyphens."""
    s = unicodedata.normalize("NFKD", title)
    s = s.encode("ascii", "ignore").decode("ascii")
    s = s.lower()
    s = re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9]+", "-", s)
    return s.strip("-")
EOF
cat > textutil/truncate.py <<'EOF'
"""Text truncation for previews."""

ELLIPSIS = "..."


def truncate(text, limit):
    """Shorten text to at most `limit` characters, cutting at a word boundary and adding "..."."""
    if len(text) <= limit:
        return text
    budget = max(0, limit - len(ELLIPSIS))
    # Keep the window text[:budget]; if the character right after it is a
    # space, the window ends on a full word, otherwise drop the partial word.
    if budget < len(text) and text[budget].isspace():
        head = text[:budget]
    else:
        head = text[:budget].rsplit(None, 1)[0] if text[:budget].split() else ""
        if head and not text[:budget][len(head):].strip() == "":
            pass
    head = head.rstrip()
    return head + ELLIPSIS
EOF

"""Text truncation for previews."""

ELLIPSIS = "..."


def truncate(text, limit):
    """Shorten text to at most `limit` characters, cutting at a word boundary and adding "..."."""
    if len(text) <= limit:
        return text
    budget = max(0, limit - len(ELLIPSIS))
    window = text[:budget]
    if text[budget].isspace():
        # The window ends exactly at a word boundary; keep it whole.
        head = window
    else:
        # Drop the partial word at the end of the window (empty if none fits).
        i = len(window)
        while i > 0 and not window[i - 1].isspace():
            i -= 1
        head = window[:i]
    return head.rstrip() + ELLIPSIS
EOF

"""URL slugs."""

import re
import unicodedata


def slugify(title):
    """Lowercase ASCII slug: accents folded to base letters, words joined by single hyphens."""
    s = unicodedata.normalize("NFKD", title)
    s = s.encode("ascii", "ignore").decode("ascii")
    s = s.lower()
    s = re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9]+", "-", s)
    return s.strip("-")

"""Text truncation for previews."""

ELLIPSIS = "..."


def truncate(text, limit):
    """Shorten text to at most `limit` characters, cutting at a word boundary and adding "..."."""
    if len(text) <= limit:
        return text
    budget = max(0, limit - len(ELLIPSIS))
    window = text[:budget]
    if text[budget].isspace():
        # The window ends exactly at a word boundary; keep it whole.
        head = window
    else:
        # Drop the partial word at the end of the window (empty if none fits).
        i = len(window)
        while i > 0 and not window[i - 1].isspace():
            i -= 1
        head = window[:i]
    return head.rstrip() + ELLIPSIS
